description: Activate when: someone says 'I'm T-shaped' and you want to verify it; a team can't translate insights across functions; a person asks what career move creates the most leverage; building a first startup team; a domain expert is hitting a ceiling and considering broadening. Do NOT activate when: the role requires pure depth with no cross-domain translation value; the team is tightly integrated with no structural holes to fill. More: deciqai.com/c/t-shaped-connector
